in_marathi.name: Bhramari
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhramari हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhramari is a goddess in Hindu mythology, often depicted as a bee. She is believed to be the mother of all bees and is associated with creation, fertility, and abundance. She is also believed to have the power to grant blessings for prosperity and happiness.
